items.title: AI-Enabled Skill Intelligence & Learning Platform
items.description: A Smart India Hackathon 2026 submission for problem statement SIH26101, conceived as a skill-intelligence and learning platform. Skill-gap analysis, relevant learning-resource discovery, and persistent vector storage for learner and quiz data are planned rather than confirmed features of the deployed build. iGOT Karmayogi integration is an intended future path, not a completed integration.
items.role: Team lead: coordinated work distribution and follow-up, provided technical guidance on technology-stack choices, and helped shape the project vision and future extensions. Separately built a RAG-based quiz-generator prototype using vector embeddings stored in ChromaDB; this prototype was not included in the hosted or submitted build.
outcomes: Submitted to Smart India Hackathon 2026; frontend and backend prototypes are deployed.
Deployed features: course enrolment, current skill-score display, and course-specific quiz generation using the Gemini API.

items.title: Flask E-commerce Application
items.description: An online shop in development, built with Flask to practise web application development and session-based state management. The current implementation includes a Bootstrap interface and a session-based cart.
outcomes: Implemented so far: Bootstrap interface and session-based cart functionality.
